titles.native: ホリデイラブ 〜夫婦間恋愛〜

description:
The story depicts adultery among two married couples. 30-year-old housewife Azu Takamori has opened a nail salon. She feels her husband Junpei does not love her as a woman, but goes about her daily life as normal. Then, Junpei's adultery comes to light.

(Source: Anime News Network)
